column10: (Id10398) Je, wewe au mama wa mtoto alitokwa na maji yenye harufu mbaya ukeni wakati wa ujauzito au baada ya kujifungua?
column11: (Id10398) ¿Tuvo usted o la madre del bebé flujo vaginal maloliente durante el embarazo o después del parto?
column18: Foul smelling secretions from the child birth canal indicate a serious infection, and are usually accompanied by pain in the lower abdomen, and fever. Such infections can be transmitted to the neonate, and cause serious illness leading to neonatal death. It is likely for the mother to remember and recall this sign if probed carefully.

column6: (Id10399) During the last 3 months of pregnancy, labour or delivery, did you/the baby's mother suffer from convulsions?
column7: (Id10399) Pendant les 3 derniers mois de la grossesse, le travail ou l'accouchement, est-ce que vous/la mère du bébé avez eu des convulsions?
column8: (Id10399) Você/a mãe do bebé sofreu de convulsões durante os últimos 3 meses de gravidez, durante o trabalho de parto ou no parto?
column9: (Id10399) خلال الأشهر الـ 3 الأخيرة من الحمل، أو المخاض، أو الولادة هل عانيتِ/عانت أم الطفل من التشنجات(الاختلاجات)؟
column10: (Id10399) Je, wewe au mama wa mtoto alipatwa na degedege katika kipindi cha miezi 3 ya mwisho ya ujauzito, wakati wa uchungu wa uzazi au wakati wa kujifungua?
column11: (Id10399) ¿Tuvo usted o la madre del bebé convulsiones durante los últimos 3 meses del embarazo, el trabajo de parto o el parto?
column18: Convulsions are rapid twitching or jerking movements of parts of the limbs or sometimes entire limbs, that usually lasts for few minutes and stops when the person becomes unconscious. The common term for convulsions is fits, and there is often a local term for such movements. In some instances, high blood pressure during pregnancy can lead to such fits, particularly in the last 3 months. In the absence of proper antenatal care, such convulsions may be the only major sign of underlying high blood pressure in pregnant women, with its known risks to the neonate as described above. Convulsions may also only occur during labour or delivery, which is a serious and dramatic event, and would be readily recalled. Clarify the meaning of the term convulsions, the period of interest (last 3 months) and record the response.

column6: (Id10400) During the last 3 months of pregnancy did you/the baby's mother suffer from blurred vision?
column7: (Id10400) Au cours des 3 derniers mois de la grossesse, avez-vous ou la mère du bébé souffert de vision floue?
column8: (Id10400) Você/a mãe do bebé sofreu de visão turva nos últimos 3 meses de gravidez?
column9: (Id10400) خلال الأشهر الـ 3 الأخيرة من الحمل، هل عانيتِ/عانت أم الطفل من زغللة الرؤية؟
column10: (Id10400) Je, wewe au mama wa mtoto alipata kuona kwa ukungu katika kipindi cha miezi 3 ya mwisho ya ujauzito?
column11: (Id10400) ¿Tuvo usted o la madre del bebé visión borrosa durante los últimos 3 meses del embarazo?
column18: Blurred vision is defined as seeing objects without clear shape or margins, or seeing double objects. This is also a sign of high blood pressure in pregnancy, but may be difficult to remember and recall by the mother but careful probing may obtain an accurate response.

column6: (Id10401) Did you/the baby's mother have severe anemia?
column7: (Id10401) Est-ce que vous/la mère du bébé souffriez d'anémie sévère?
column8: (Id10401) Você/a mãe do bebé sofreu de anemia grave?
column9: (Id10401) هل أُصبتِ/أصيبت أم الطفل بفقر الدم (أنيميا) الشديد ؟
column10: (Id10401) Je, wewe au mama wa mtoto alikuwa na upungufu mkubwa wa damu?
column11: (Id10401) ¿Tuvo usted o la madre del bebé anemia grave?
column18: In some instances, pregnancy is associated with severe “thinning” of the blood, which is observed as white or light colour of the tongue, nails, palms and eye margins. This condition is known as anaemia, and is associated with premature delivery, low birth weight, birth asphyxia and other complications. Hence, identification of maternal anaemia helps with the diagnosis of the cause of neonatal death.

column6: (Id10402) Did you/the baby's mother have vaginal bleeding during the last 3 months of pregnancy but before labour started?
column7: (Id10402) Avez-vous ou la mère du bébé eu des saignements vaginaux pendant les 3 derniers mois de la grossesse mais avant le début du travail d'accouchement?
column8: (Id10402) Você/a mãe do bebé teve sangramento vaginal nos últimos 3 meses de gravidez mas antes do começo de trabalho de parto?
column9: (Id10402) هل كان لديكِ/لدى أم الطفل نزف مهبلي خلال الأشهر الـ 3 الأخيرة من الحمل لكن قبل بدء المخاض؟
column10: (Id10402) Je, wewe au mama wa mtoto alitokwa damu ukeni katika kipindi cha miezi 3 ya mwisho ya ujauzito, lakini kabla ya uchungu wa uzazi kuanza?
column11: (Id10402) ¿Tuvo usted o la madre del bebé sangrado vaginal durante los últimos 3 meses del embarazo, pero antes de que empezara el trabajo de parto?
column18: Bleeding from the birth canal before the start of labour is an important sign, and is often associated with a disorder of the placenta (use local term). Excessive bleeding endangers the life of both the mother and the neonate. This is usually readily recalled and reported by the mother.

column6: (Id10403) Did the baby's bottom, feet, arm or hand come out of the vagina before its head?

While alcohol may be directly related to the specific event or circumstance leading to death, there could be an underlying risk associated with chronic or regular alcohol consumption. This question is intended to capture regular consumption at least once a week or more often. Note any specific details provided by the respondent in the narrative section of the questionnaire. column18: In many instances of deaths that occur at home, there is a potential for the deceased to have received some form of medical attention during the illness that led to death. The treatment could have been in the form of a duration of hospitalisation which later resulted in the person being discharged prior to death, which sometimes occurs in instances where there is no potential cure, or the treatment is too expensive, or a cultural preference for terminal care at home. In such instances, there is a likelihood of household members to be aware of the nature of medical treatment provided, as well as some information on the likely disease or condition that the patient was suffering. In the following questions, record specific responses about health services as asked, and record any other or allied information on health services or medical opinion as to the cause in the narrative section of the questionnaire. This section should always be completed at the end of the interview.

column6: (Id10418) Did (s)he receive any treatment for the illness that led to death?

column8: (Id10418) A pessoa recebeu algum tratamento para a doença que conduziu à morte?
column9: (Id10418) هل تلقَّى/تلقَّت أي علاج للمرض الذي أدى إلى الوفاة؟

column18: This question refers to formal health treatment, and not traditional medicines, home remedies or non-professional treatment. If the response to this question is “NO”, then you will skip to Id10435. NOTE: These questions should be answered according to whether the patient received the treatment OR needed the treatment, as recommended by a health professional.

column6: (Id10419) Did (s)he receive oral rehydration salts?

column11: (Id10419) ¿Recibió sales de rehidratación oral?
column18: Oral rehydration salts are supplied as a packet of powder which is to be dissolved in water and given to individuals suffering from diarrhoea, particularly children. This is an effective remedy which is known to prevent death. This question only refers to packets supplied by health professionals, and not home-made solutions. This question is directed to assess the availability and access to health services.

column9: (Id10420) هل تلقَّى/تلقَّت العلاج بالسوائل (أو احتاج/احتاجت) إلى العلاج بالسوائل االوريدية (التنقيط)؟

column11: (Id10420) ¿Recibió (o necesitó) tratamiento de líquidos intravenosos (suero)?
column18: A drip is usually administered in a health centre by a trained health care worker. Administration of a drip is suggestive of serious conditions such as dehydration.

column11: (Id10421) ¿Recibió (o necesitó) una transfusión de sangre?
column18: A blood transfusion is also an indication of the severity of the illness, and can be suggestive of causes of death associated with acute blood loss.

column18: Feeding through the nasal tube indicates potential damage to the nervous system, and problems in such a manner of feeding can result in partial vomiting and infection of the lungs, leading to death. Enquire about the duration for which feeding was provided through the tube, and whether the tube was in place right up to death, and record all these details in the narrative section of the questionnaire.

column14: Antibióticos injetáveis excluem imunização, vacinas e remédios contra a dor. Os antibióticos são dados para agir contra infeções (germes).

column16: Antibiotiki kwa njia ya sindano hazihusishi chanjo, dawa za maumivu au kinga nyingine. Dawa hizi hutolewa dhidi ya maambukizi ya vimelea vya maradhi (vijidudu).
column17: Los antibióticos inyectables excluyen las inmunizaciones, las vacunas y los analgésicos. Los antibióticos se administran contra las infecciones (es decir, los gérmenes).
column18: Injectable antibiotics exclude immunizations, vaccines and pain killers. Injectable antibiotics are medications against bacterial infections administered by needle. They are indicative of serious infection of any part or parts of the body, and are administered almost always only in health facilities. However, details of such treatment may or may not be shared with family members.

column18: ART drug therapy is given to patients with HIV. column13: Cette section vise à collecter des informations à partir du certificat médical standard international sur la cause du décès. Ce niveau de détail peut ou non être présent dans le certificat de décès délivré à la famille. Inscrivez "non" si l'information médicale sur la cause du décès n'est pas disponible. Le certificat médical de la cause du décès est généralement obtenu auprès d'un médecin dans un hôpital et doit être distingué du certificat de décès qui est délivré par l'organisme d'enregistrement des faits d'état civil.
column14: Esta secção serve para coletar informações para o padrão internacional de certificado médico da causa do óbito.
